messages:
Maya: opened PR with Windows offline installer + KMS/HSM appendix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4972. Includes HTTPS mirror, SMB appendix, PowerShell checksum, and PKCS#11 tips.

Theo: quick Q — do we prefer HTTPS mirrors for most customers? SMB examples are fine for LANs but need more creds guidance.

Maya: Yes, default to HTTPS mirror in the main flow; keep SMB as Appendix B with troubleshooting. Added net use example and service account perms note.

Asha: Please add Windows HSM driver signing guidance and the vendor install order: driver -> middleware -> agent. Customers often miss that.

Maya: Added a short checklist and a tiny table mapping common vendors -> example PKCS11 DLL paths. Also included a one-liner to verify SHA256 after download:

powershell
$h=Get-FileHash .\\redwood.zip -Algorithm SHA256; if ($h.Hash -ne 'REPLACE') { throw 'bad checksum' }

build-bot: CI windows-smoke failed on branch: failed to access \\\\mirror\artifacts (401). Log attached.

Theo: Likely credential scope problem. Recommend showing net use /user:DOMAIN\\svc_redwood and how to persist creds. Also swap wording "open firewall ports" -> "allow egress to mirror host on 443/445 as applicable".

Maya: Updated docs with net use snippet, firewall wording, and an HTTPS mTLS example for client certs.

docs-bot: link-checker/4972 found one broken anchor in hsm/windows.md. Suggested anchor rename to pkcs11-windows.

Maya: Fixed anchor and pushed. Folks, can you do a quick review? I'd like to merge before next week's docs freeze.

Asha: LGTM after small driver-signing/registry note I suggested. Approve pending that.

Theo: LGTM for infra text. Approve once Asha's note is in.

Maya: Thanks — will add the registry snippet and merge when CI green. I'll follow up with a short migration checklist for customers moving from Linux quickstart to Windows offline flow.
